title: Transform text
subtitle: Same language, new editorial treatment.
profile_active_note: The book profile and scoped glossary will be used.
profile_prep_subtitle: Analyze a whole book before translating or transforming to create a book-specific profile with glossary, entities, voices, sections, and editorial risks.
profile_prep_help: DeepSeek Flash reads the whole book in chunks, extracts useful names, concepts, address forms, and editorial questions, creates a book profile, and makes it available in the selector.
profile_prep_drop_title: Drop files to prepare a profile
profile_prep_running: DeepSeek Flash is reading the whole book in chunks and consolidating useful suggestions...
profile_prep_success: Profile ready: {{approved}} safe entries, {{pending}} suggestions to review, and {{signals}} editorial signals.
profile_prep_saved_result: {{name}} saved automatically: {{approved}} safe entries, {{pending}} pending suggestions, {{signals}} editorial signals.
mode_modernize_desc: Update old prose into a faithful contemporary version.
mode_simplify_desc: Rewrite in clear university-level prose, explaining complex concepts, tables, and arguments without losing rigor.
mode_humanize_desc: Remove AI stiffness and make the text feel more natural.
mode_mexican_desc: Adapt into natural Mexican or Latin American Spanish.
mode_academic_desc: Organize and clarify dense academic prose.
mode_literary_desc: Improve rhythm, diction, and literary flow.
mode_ocr_desc: Repair OCR noise, line breaks, spacing, and structure.
drop_files_support: PDF, TXT, EPUB, DOCX, and text files
select_file_first: Select at least one file to transform.
profile_prep_reconnecting: Connection is unstable; retrying the profile status check ({{seconds}}s). The analysis is still running in the background.
profile_prep_reconnect_failed: The server connection was lost while preparing the profile. The process may still be running; refresh the page to check whether it finished. Last error: {{error}}
